First-person POV of a tired teenage boy standing beside the school running track after a football game at golden hour. Four girls gather in front of the camera with concerned expressions. The girl in the pink hoodie looks especially cute and worried, slightly leaning forward. The girl in the blue-and-white school uniform stands in the middle holding a drink bottle, looking gentle and attentive. The tall girl in the gray top remains calm and cool, while the girl at the right edge watches quietly. Warm sunset backlight, candid school-life atmosphere, natural handheld feeling. The pink-hoodie girl speaks softly and anxiously: “你踢完啦？累不累呀？看你都喘成这样了。” |  | First-person POV, the girls move a little closer and look directly into the camera as if checking the boy’s condition. The pink-hoodie girl remains sweet and expressive, the school-uniform girl looks caring and practical, the gray-top girl stands behind with a composed, slightly aloof attitude, and the striped-top girl quietly observes from the side. The overall mood is warm and caring, with slight camera sway and sunset glow. The school-uniform girl gently says: “先别说话，缓一缓。”  | First-person POV, the pink-hoodie girl becomes the main emotional focus. She leans closer toward the camera with a soft, cute, slightly exaggerated worried expression, as if trying to cheer the boy up while still fussing over him. The other girls stay around her, listening and reacting naturally. Warm golden light, shallow depth of field, emotional but youthful tone. The pink-hoodie girl says with playful concern: “你刚刚是不是太拼了呀？” | 
First-person POV, the blue-and-white school-uniform girl steps slightly forward and becomes the center of the frame. She has a gentle, dependable personality and quietly takes care of the boy. She holds a small drink bottle and offers it toward the camera, with a soft and sincere expression. The pink-hoodie girl watches supportively, the gray-top girl stays calm in the back, and the striped-top girl looks on quietly. Natural school sports-day atmosphere, warm sunset rim light. The school-uniform girl says in a caring voice: “给你，先喝点水。”  | First-person POV, the tall girl in the gray top becomes the visual focus. She has a cooler, more reserved personality, with a composed face and a slightly aloof but genuinely concerned attitude. She looks directly at the camera and speaks in a calm, low-key way, while the others remain nearby. The pink girl still looks cute and supportive, the uniform girl stays attentive, and the striped-top girl remains quiet. Golden-hour backlight, natural candid framing, subtle emotional tension. The gray-top girl says: “踢球而已，别这么拼命。”  | First-person POV, the mood becomes lighter. The striped-top girl at the right side is still more quiet than the others, but she finally leans in a little and speaks with a calm, sincere tone. She feels like the least talkative one, but she is still caring in her own way. The school-uniform girl continues holding the drink, the pink-hoodie girl looks sweet and encouraging, and the gray-top girl watches with a cool expression. Slight handheld movement, intimate school-life feeling, sunset highlights. The striped-top girl says quietly: “你今天已经很厉害了。”  | First-person POV, final comforting group moment. All four girls stand closely together in front of the camera with warm and supportive expressions. The pink-hoodie girl looks cute and caring, the school-uniform girl remains gentle and nurturing, the gray-top girl is calm and quietly protective, and the striped-top girl looks soft and sincere. The scene feels like the emotional ending of a youthful school sports moment. Warm golden sunlight, stadium crowd blurred in the background, natural handheld finish, comforting atmosphere. The girls speak together in a supportive way: “先休息一下吧，我们陪你。”
